subject: 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda Framework
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed a comprehensive governing agenda for the 2024-2025 term, which organizes legislative priorities and major projects by committee. The council referred the framework to individual committees and established a schedule for regular maintenance and biannual reviews of the document.

items.title: Governing Agenda Framework
items.summary: Referred the 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda to all committees to serve as a roadmap for legislative and policy goals during the current term.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Ordinances
items.summary: Reviewed three pending ordinances regarding tree preservation, leaf blowers, and food trucks slated for completion within the next six months.

items.title: Administration and Finance Priorities
items.summary: Discussed fiscal priorities including the annual budget process, proposed commercial vacancy taxes, and a 'percent for art' ordinance.

items.title: Education and Culture Priorities
items.summary: Explored new initiatives for student internships at city hall, nature-based learning in the Fells, and a city-wide 'Lemonade Stand Days' event.

items.title: Governance Committee Priorities
items.summary: Outlined a 12-to-18-month project to update the city charter alongside reviews of election oversight and board stipends.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Priorities
items.summary: Designated zoning reform as a central priority for the term while reviewing housing and transportation safety ordinances.

items.title: Public Health and Community Safety Priorities
items.summary: Discussed establishing seasonal warming and cooling centers, plant medicine decriminalization, and reproductive health protections.

items.title: Public Works and Facilities Priorities
items.summary: Evaluated infrastructure needs with an extensive discussion on the financial and legal challenges of rehabilitating private ways and aging water systems.

items.title: Resident Services and Public Engagement Priorities
items.summary: Reviewed goals for a multilingual resident guide, youth commission formation, and human rights commission reform.

items.title: Agenda Review and Maintenance
items.summary: Approved a motion for council leadership to update the governing agenda monthly and for the full body to conduct formal reviews in June and December.
